Titanium import-price forecast evaluation

Direct H3, H6 and H12 GBP/kg probabilistic forecasts for HS 810820 and HS 810890. The feature set excludes USGS titanium sponge data and World Bank aluminium/nickel proxies. Model and baseline interval calibration now use their own independent pre-February-2022 residual histories.

Decision boundary

V6 uses UK titanium import history, Bank of England FX, ERUC/PPI, supplier structure, seasonality and data-quality features. Cross-metal World Bank proxies and stale USGS inputs are excluded. Baseline calibration is isolated from selected-model calibration, making MIS comparisons reproducible and fair.
